requirement_text: M16 node-to-node supervision shall use a contract distinct from Guardian Protocol v0.1 host/device command semantics.
verification_method: Controlled document/interface review; direct cross-protocol regression is not registered.
expected_result: NodeLink remains a separate node-supervision contract; Guardian Protocol v0.1 host/device semantics remain unchanged.
actual_result: NOT_ASSESSED; architecture text exists, but no direct test or independent review is registered.
notes: Candidate ADR/spec mapping only. Stakeholder need, hazard ID, direct test, accepted evidence and reviewer are not registered. HOLD.

requirement_text: Successful node authentication shall not directly grant physical actuation authority.
verification_method: Host negative tests for authentication and role-based actuation boundary; host scope only.
expected_result: Authentication and supervisory/witness/computational roles do not grant actuation; unauthorized role requests fail closed.
actual_result: PASS_HOST_CI|M17 run 45885029914 (01-multinode O0/O2); middleware run 45885029750 (C5-R1 auth). Not physical evidence.
notes: Source/CI mapping only. No hazard allocation or independent reviewer; requirement status remains NOT_DEMONSTRATED/HOLD.

requirement_text: Within one initialized runtime session, NodeLink shall reject duplicate or regressing sequence values.
verification_method: Session-local host positive/negative unit test; not persistent anti-replay.
expected_result: Accept increasing sequence; reject duplicate, zero and regressing values in one initialized session.
actual_result: Registered HOST_EXECUTION artifact reports PASS at source commit 50c34dd540ed9f9c658e6cb8c6d26e58594d4846; artifact hash remains in evidence register.
notes: Evidence predates current baseline; project-state/materialization coherence and independent review remain unresolved. Preserve HOLD.

requirement_text: Loss of the supervisory link shall resolve through a deterministic bounded local state and shall not silently increase authority.
verification_method: M17 host supervisor positive/negative tests; software fixture only.
expected_result: Missed heartbeat reaches SAFE_HOLD and requests recovery without transferring actuation authority.
actual_result: PASS_HOST_CI|M17 run 45885029914 (02-nxp-supervisor O0/O2). Not physical link-loss evidence.
notes: No hardware timing evidence, hazard allocation, direct evidence admission or independent review. HOLD.

requirement_text: Disagreement between the STM32F401 node and the NXP supervisory node shall not silently grant unilateral authority to either node.
verification_method: Host disagreement test and separate role/actuation negative test.
expected_result: Disagreement degrades supervision; supervisory node cannot gain direct actuation authority.
actual_result: PASS_HOST_CI|M17 run 45885029914 (01-multinode and 02-nxp-supervisor O0/O2). Not distributed physical qualification.
notes: Host simulation does not establish partition/split-brain safety. Hazard IDs, physical evidence and independent review remain unregistered; HOLD.

actual_result: Source mapping observed; exact test execution is not separately registered. NOT_ASSESSED.

requirement_text: NodeLink CRC integrity shall not be represented as cryptographic authentication.
